kind_of_thing.quote: Fenugreek is a plant in the family Fabaceae.

extinct.why: The sources describe fenugreek as an annual plant that is cultivated worldwide, so it is still living.

kind_of_plant.why: Fenugreek is an herb whose leaves and seeds are eaten as food, so a parent would call it a vegetable plant rather than a tree, flower, or grain.

part_we_eat.why: The sources say fenugreek's leaves are used as a herb and eaten, so the part we eat is the leaves.
